summary: Added input validation to POST and PATCH /todos endpoints. POST rejects missing, null, blank, and non-string titles. PATCH rejects empty/whitespace titles and non-boolean completed values. All errors return 400 with JSON { error: '...' }. 11 new tests in validation.test.ts, all 26 tests pass, build clean.

verification_results.details: 26 tests passed across 5 test files (including 11 new validation tests)

notes: PATCH validation only rejects when fields are provided with invalid values — omitting title or completed is allowed for partial updates
